projects.name: EveryRupee
projects.tag: AI-assisted personal finance web app (team project)
bullets: Addresses low financial literacy and scam awareness among everyday users in India with free, jargon-free tools.
Built the Financial Education hub in HTML, CSS and JavaScript: eight topics (cards, UPI, net banking, loans, EMI, KYC) plus a glossary.
Team project spanning planner, tax and investment pages, deployed on Vercel; includes a finance-only assistant on the Google Gemini API, restricted to finance questions.
MIT-licensed public repository with contributor guidelines and labelled issues for outside contributors.

site.problem: Many people in India learn about loans, cards and UPI scams only after something goes wrong. EveryRupee explains money in plain language, with fraud warnings, and helps people plan. It is free and needs no signup.
site.mine: The Financial Education hub: eight topics (debit and credit cards, net banking, UPI, cheques, loans, EMI and bank documentation), each with fraud warnings, plus a plain-language glossary.
site.team: A multi-step financial planner, tax and investment pages, and a finance-only assistant built on the Google Gemini API and restricted to finance questions.
site.open: The repository is MIT-licensed and has a contributor guide and labelled issues for newcomers.

projects.name: Mitti AI
projects.tag: AI marketing assistant for clay and terracotta artisans (team project)
bullets: Conceived the idea: help artisans without marketing skills present handmade products online.
Built the AI generation section using the Google Gemini API: a product photo upload produces a description, Instagram caption, SEO keywords and design ideas.
Team delivered the web interface (landing page, dashboard, idea generator) and deployed it on Vercel.

site.problem: Clay and terracotta artisans make beautiful products but often have no marketing skills to show them online. Mitti AI turns one product photo into the words they need.
site.mine: The idea, and the AI generation section: a product photo goes to the Google Gemini API and comes back as a description, an Instagram caption, SEO keywords and design ideas.
site.team: The web interface: landing page, dashboard and idea generator.

site.intro: Second-year B.Tech student at Bharati Vidyapeeth's College of Engineering, New Delhi. I build small web tools with teammates, add AI where it helps, and I'm learning Rust to prepare for open-source work.
about: I study B.Tech at Bharati Vidyapeeth's College of Engineering in New Delhi and graduate in 2029.

My projects so far are web tools built with teammates: a finance education and planning site, EveryRupee, and a marketing assistant for clay artisans, Mitti AI. Both call the Google Gemini API, and I came up with the Mitti AI idea and built its AI section.
I also run outreach for Techshuttle, my college's technical society. Right now I'm learning Rust and looking for open-source programs where I can start contributing.

skillNotes.Learning: Currently learning. Not yet used in a shipped project.

openSource.lead: I have not made upstream contributions yet. This is the direction I am working toward.
points: I want to contribute through programs like Google Summer of Code and Linux Foundation mentorships.
I am learning Rust and systems programming to get ready for projects in that space.
I already run a public repository the way I'd like to work in: EveryRupee has an MIT licence, a contributor guide and labelled issues.
